Post-speech (recovery) HR at 1-week follow-up, affect-label vs. control, from the Table 2 means/SDs: 90.2 (9.4) vs. 92.2 (8.8), n=27 per arm. Recovery window chosen to match Niles 2015. LIMITATION: arms are not balanced at pre-test (the affect-label arm starts ~3-4 bpm high), so the pre->1wk change score gives d = -0.49 instead; that is reported as a sensitivity analysis, not the primary value, because its SE needs a pre-post correlation the paper does not report. Healthy-control emotion-induction SCR, label vs. control, computed from the Table 3 HC means/SDs averaged over the two script types: label 3.095 vs. control 3.205, pooled SD 3.020, n=30 within-subject. The paper reports no HC-only inferential test (no post-hoc was run because the condition x group interaction was n.s.), so this comes from the descriptives. LIMITATION: SCR here is an overdispersed count per 30 s epoch (SD > M) which the authors modelled with a negative-binomial GEE adjusting for baseline SCR, dissociation and alexithymia; an SMD on the raw descriptives is a crude summary of that model.
